Use a paper guide instead

If the account guide does not open, use these written steps. No sign-in is needed.

Write your notes on your own paper. This page does not save or send them.

  1. Choose the paper you have

    A passbook, deposit receipt or share or fund statement is enough to start.

  2. Check the nomination status

    Check the latest statement or ask the institution. A remembered nomination may need confirmation.

  3. Get the right form

    Ask for the form to add or change a nominee for this account.

  4. Match the account number

    Find the number on your statement. Copy it into the official form and check each character. Do not enter it here.

  5. Name the person you want to nominate

    On the official form, enter their full name and how they are related to the account holder.

  6. Is a nominee a child?

    Check their date of birth. Ask the bank or company if its child-nominee rules apply. Do not guess.

  7. Check and send the form

    Check the account, names and consent privately. Send the form through the official service. Keep its receipt.

  8. What does the reply say?

    A receipt means the form arrived. It does not mean the nominee was recorded.

  9. Your family record

    Ask your chosen person to try these tasks using the sheet, without your instructions. Record only what they could do.

Do not share passwords, PINs or OTPs.

If more than one person holds the account, ask how every required holder agrees. A helper must not sign for you.

Nothing is sent from this website.

Need help with old shares or savings?

Enter identifying details only in the official search service. If nothing is found, ask the institution; a negative search is not proof that no holding exists.

  • Read about finding old fund accounts
  • Open RBI deposit search
  • Open the official unclaimed-shares website

A bank or company has not fixed your problem?

First write to the bank or company. Say what went wrong and what you want fixed. Keep its reply.

For a securities complaint, SCORES gives 15 days from receipt of the company’s report to ask for first review, and 15 days from receipt of the designated body’s report for second review. Check the deadline shown in the portal.

Open official share-market complaints

First complain to your bank. If it does not fix the problem, check the Reserve Bank complaint instructions. SCORES is not for bank deposits.

Guidance checked: 4 October 2026. Ask the bank or company about current requirements.
